sources.title: Qualcomm
sources.snippet: Qualcomm Incorporated is an American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing,
Qualcomm sold its manufacturing interests to Kyocera Corporation, a Japanese CDMA manufacturer and Qualcomm licensee.
Our primary semiconductor manufacturing suppliers include: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company · Samsung Electronics · Global Foundries · Advan
